summary: A substantial trip extension for immersive music, art installations, workshops and food, rather than a Bangkok attraction. Official sources confirm 3–7 December 2026 at The Fields, Siam Country Club, Chonburi near Pattaya. The separate Kyoto gathering is not a relocation; no cancellation was announced on the official pages checked.
whyGo: Explore unusual temporary stages and installations alongside an extensive music program.
Stay into sunrise instead of rushing a conventional concert; combine sound, food and participatory experiences.
bestFor: Electronic music and outdoor festival enthusiasts
Travellers willing to spend several nights and a substantial budget on one experience
skipIf: Your Bangkok schedule allows only a quick outing
You need quiet sleep, guaranteed seated comfort or predictable low spending
duration: Allow 2–4 nights plus transfers; Sunday admission offers a shorter taste.
cost: November advertised prices: THB 12,900 full pass or THB 11,500 weekend; Sunday THB 5,000. Door prices advertised at THB 20,000 / 15,000 / 6,500 respectively, subject to capacity. Accommodation, transport, food and booking charges are extra; confirm final checkout total.
hours: 3–7 December 2026. Entry Thursday 16:00–midnight; Friday–Sunday 08:00–midnight. Programming continues overnight; Monday is not a fresh entry day.
bestTime: Choose a sunset-to-sunrise visit if music and installations are the draw; protect recovery time the next day.
gettingThere: Travel from Bangkok to the Pattaya/Chonburi area, then arrange the final transfer to The Fields. Stay nearby or camp. Official 2026 shuttle schedules and prices remain forthcoming; do not use the dated 2024 transport article as a current timetable.
booking: As of 17 October, the next announced full/weekend sale is 3–9 November at 16:00 Bangkok time, subject to availability. Buy through the official site. Terms state purchases are non-refundable and non-transferable; verify conditions before paying.
accessibility: Outdoor fields and substantial walking are expected. Step-free routes, accessible toilets and assistance arrangements were not established in the checked sources; confirm specific needs before committing.
practicalTips: Bring an empty reusable bottle for free refill stations, sun protection, comfortable footwear and earplugs.
Food and drink spending uses a cashless wristband; outside food and drinks face restrictions.
Camping accommodation requires a separate booking; decide your sleep and return-transfer plan before buying admission.
decemberNotes: Only 3–7 December matches this festival. The weekend pass starts Saturday 5 December at 08:00; Sunday pass starts 6 December at 08:00 and runs through Monday sunrise. Expect warm daytime outdoor conditions.
uncertainties: Final performance timetable, 2026 shuttle prices and accessible facilities remain unconfirmed.
Official pages contain some stale historical copy; reconfirm details close to departure.
Current remaining ticket and accommodation inventory is not guaranteed.
